notes: «ح» joins two branches that each name Musa; the tail «قال سمعت أبي أنه، سمع عقبة بن عامر» is written once after both
«- والإخبار في حديث وهب -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«أبي» is a relation with no name in the text

fixes.reason: HKG gives the father a name, علي بن رباح, which the text writes only as أبي
